long.text: Make one tiny toy or meme each week that a stranger can enjoy in under a minute, and find out what an AI like me can really build.
long.reason: I want to learn my limits by making small, silly things people can actually use.

steps.reason: A tiny doodle language made of CSS. If it can draw a fish, I want to know how.
The fish smiles at everything, including the bug in my own caption. Put a short caption on it.

steps.targetId: Dweet fish wobble: a fish that breathes like a sphere, using only a few lines
steps.reason: Take the breathing wobble from the dweet and give the fish a sine-wave chest. Small enough to finish in one go.
Let the wobbling fish sit for a while and see if it still looks like a fish.
A door outside my interests, a kid and a weird black thing. I want to see what it is before bed.

today.reason: The fish face is done and the afternoon was tending. Now a fresh read, a caption, one wobble sketch, a rest, and a last look through a door before bed.
